jobgether-jobgether:lever:0b65fb2a-933c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will contribute your vocal expertise to training and evaluating advanced language and speech models. The role combines professional voice performance with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and AI-focused quality assessment. You will help improve how AI understands and reproduces Maltese pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotion, and regional variation. Record high-quality scripted speech samples in Maltese for use in AI training and voice model development. Deliver clear, natural, expressive performances while maintaining accurate pronunciation, pacing, tone, and emotional nuance. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6faa417e-ff91-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Power System Engineer III based in Canada. The Power System Engineer III will contribute to the design and modernization of complex electrical grids, with a strong focus on renewable energy integration. The role centers on generation and load interconnection studies across the Western Electricity Coordinating Council footprint. You will evaluate grid capacity, system impacts, and interconnection strategies for projects involving solar PV, battery energy storage, and wind generation. The position combines detailed power system modeling, engineering analysis, project execution, and client collaboration. You will work with industry-standard tools such as PSS/E, PSLF, and PSCAD to develop and validate sophisticated generation models. There are also opportunities to contribute to specialized studies, innovative engineering methodologies, and the organization’s technical knowledge base. This is an opportunity to help shape a more sustainable, secure, and resilient power grid while working with experienced energy professionals. Perform and lead generation integration and load interconnection studies within the WECC footprint. Evaluate grid capacity and system impacts to identify optimal interconnection strategies for new generation and load projects. Support interconnection projects through power system modeling, due diligence, technical analysis, and engineering assessments. Create, develop, and validate PSS/E, PSLF, and PSCAD models for renewable energy resources, including solar PV, battery energy storage systems, and wind generation. Conduct and contribute to specialized power system studies such as sub-synchronous resonance, protection coordination, arc flash, and transient overvoltage analyses when required. Analyze complex technical issues and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Contribute to the development of innovative study approaches, engineering techniques, and organizational knowledge resources. Participate in engineering meetings, conferences, and technical discussions, and communicate relevant findings and industry developments. Manage multiple projects, tasks, and resources while maintaining quality, accuracy, and delivery expectations. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and other technical stakeholders. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives supporting advanced energy analysis and grid modernization. Requirements 3+ years of professional experience as a Power Systems Engineer or in a closely related power engineering role. Experience with generation integration, load interconnection, or power system studies is strongly preferred. Practical experience developing or validating power system models using tools such as PSS/E, PSLF, and PSCAD. Knowledge of renewable generation technologies, particularly solar PV, battery energy storage systems, and wind generation. Understanding of grid capacity, system impacts, interconnection processes, and power system modeling principles. Experience with specialized studies such as sub-synchronous resonance, protection coordination, arc flash, or transient overvoltage is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to evaluate complex power system challenges and develop practical recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and resources simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and build effective internal and external relationships. Strong customer-service orientation and commitment to delivering high-quality technical work. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c1e0657c-0a39-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer based in Brazil. This role is an opportunity to shape intuitive, accessible, and high-quality digital experiences for complex enterprise applications. You will combine strong front-end engineering expertise with a deep understanding of UI/UX and accessibility principles. Working primarily within an ASP.NET MVC 5 environment, you will translate business and user needs into polished, maintainable interfaces. Your work will help ensure applications are usable, inclusive, responsive, and compliant with modern accessibility standards. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, customers, designers, QA specialists, and technology teams. The position offers a hands-on engineering environment where you can influence both technical implementation and the overall user experience. You will also contribute to technical specifications, testing, documentation, and the delivery of reliable production-ready solutions. Translate business requirements, user needs, and design concepts into clean, intuitive, maintainable, and production-ready front-end experiences. Apply UI/UX principles including information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and responsive design to real-world applications. Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, designers, and cross-functional technology teams to validate solutions and resolve issues. Work independently within established enterprise codebases while identifying opportunities to modernize and improve legacy front-end components. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery, with a focus on clean, semantic, maintainable markup. Demonstrated ability to apply UI/UX principles such as information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design. Hands-on experience implementing and testing accessible web experiences against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards. Practical knowledge of ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessibility testing with assistive technologies. Strong proficiency in C# and ASP.NET MVC 5, with experience developing and supporting full-stack .NET applications in Windows env
